name: local-planner
description: Private local planner backed by SQLite

scripts.electron:package: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-electron-seed.cjs && electron-packager . "Local Planner" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --app-bundle-id=com.saarang.local-planner --extra-resource=electron-seed --ignore="^/(\.data|\.git|\.github|\.serena|\.worktrees|blueprint|docs|electron-seed|logs|test|release)$"
